findings.claim: Opted-in extraction refusals bypass the progress job and leave the completed UI flowchart showing every stage as pending.
findings.evidence: src/sec10k/web/app.py:447,469,495 return validation errors before _start_progress; src/sec10k/web/static/index.html:1027 handles the non-202 response with LAST_PROGRESS null and line 942 maps all stages to pending. Invalid URL, empty upload, unknown fixture, or a full queue triggers it.
findings.repro: POST /api/extract/url with X-Progress: 1 and body {"url":"not-an-edgar-url"}; observe HTTP 400 without progress_id and a failed banner above six pending nodes.
findings.acceptance: Every terminal inspector response renders terminal stage outcomes, with a behavioral web-contract case covering the error path.
findings.route_reason: Concrete terminal-state acceptance violation with reproducible UI behavior.

findings.claim: The extraction live region remains stale from request start until the first successful progress poll.
findings.evidence: src/sec10k/web/static/index.html:972 resets the graph but updates #banner only when a message is supplied; line 1025 calls busy(true) without one; line 953 updates it only after a polled active stage exists.
findings.repro: Delay the initial POST and observe #banner: controls disable and the pending graph appears, but role=status retains the previous result until progress polling succeeds.
findings.acceptance: Starting extraction immediately announces a truthful generic busy status, then backend-authored active-stage labels; a case fails if busy(true) leaves the banner unchanged.

findings.claim: The localhost proof does not demonstrate that Intel visibly advances through live routing stages.
findings.evidence: tasks/reviews/d35-localhost-proof.json records only prepare active then terminal outcomes; its callback probe lists backend events but no browser-visible snapshots. Polling every 250ms can miss synchronous quiet transitions.
findings.repro: Record each /api/progress response and rendered-node mutation during the documented localhost Intel fixture run; the current artifact lacks an intermediate rendered routing node.
findings.acceptance: Provide a deterministic localhost/browser case showing real non-instant Intel routing work active in the rendered graph before completion, retaining response-authored terminal statuses, or narrow the accepted visible sequence honestly.
findings.route_reason: The committed evidence does not establish the task's explicit localhost acceptance criterion.
